calculation_handling.description: Exclusion rule (in addition to 10.5.40.50(1)): in the R zone, the exterior sides of a lawfully existing platform that was lawfully enclosed under former City of Toronto By-law 438-86 are not main walls.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on as-built facts (a lawfully existing platform, lawfully enclosed under By-law 438-86) that we do not hold. The former by-law is referenced as the source of the enclosure's legality, not as an alternate compliance path, so it is not keyed as a PREVAILING instrument. No DSL variable is defined, so target is none.

units.disclosure: In the R zone, the outside sides of an existing platform that was legally enclosed under the old City of Toronto By-law 438-86 are not counted as main walls. We do not know whether your lot has such a platform.

10.10.40.50(1).explanation: In the R zone, if a deck or platform was legally enclosed under the former City of Toronto By-law 438-86, its outside sides are not treated as main walls (so main-wall rules do not apply to them). This adds to the general platform rule in 10.5.40.50(1).
